optimizedDescription.value: Separates VCS, content, derivation, schema, coverage, and lock health with monotonic evidence and safe stale-lock recovery.

optimizedContext.value:
# Staleness Detection

## Rules
- `IndexOptions.vcsRef?: string`; after successful index persist opaque `lastIndexedRef`. Omitted means `null`/unknown, never stale.
- VCS stale iff stored non-null ref differs from current `VcsAdapter.ref()`; fresh iff equal; null means unknown.
- Derivation fingerprint combines effective `@specd/code-graph` version, canonical resolved workspace objects, effective discovery config, newline-normalized hashes of adapter `resolutionManifests()`. CRLF/LF alone cannot mismatch.
- VCS and derivation states independent. Reads warn/surface metadata but return graph results. `graph index` repairs mismatch by visible full recreation/rebuild or clear force-required failure.
- `GraphStatistics.lastIndexedRef: string|null`. Text stale warning uses 7-char refs; no line for null. JSON/TOON: `stale`, `currentRef`, `fingerprintMismatch` each nullable.
- `@specd/code-graph` owns filesystem index lock under config graph directory; clients use shared acquire/release/`assertGraphIndexUnlocked`.
- Lock v2 stores owner `pid`, opaque process `startedAt`, ownership `token`; v1 `pid`+`token` remains readable and uses PID liveness only.
- Existing lock live when PID alive and available start time matches; stale when PID absent, reused with different start time, or malformed/unreadable beyond bounded grace. Indeterminate liveness counts live.
- Acquisition removes stale lock then race-safely retries exclusive creation; concurrent recoverers yield one owner, others typed busy. Live lock stays busy. Recovery warns through host logging without output/exit change.
- `assertGraphIndexUnlocked` ignores stale lock but never removes it; only acquisition removes. All callers, including isolated supervisor, delegate stale detection to shared lock helper.
- `isGraphStale`/fingerprint primitives remain here. `GetGraphHealth` is canonical orchestration for `graph stats`, `project status --graph`, SDK snapshots; hosts do not rebuild logic.
- Package merges workspace `allowedPaths`, `excludePaths`, `respectGitignore`, global config, runtime/CLI includes/excludes into effective `ProjectGraphConfig`.
- Missing `specd.yaml`: synthetic config maps repository root to one `default` workspace.
- Canonical health separates VCS ref, working-tree/content, derivation fingerprint, backend schema/generation, index coverage. Matching VCS ref cannot prove clean content.
- Stable reasons include dirty, unknown, partial, excluded, unsupported, parse-failed, fingerprint-mismatched, schema-incompatible. Missing symbol is stale only with current addressed content and complete supported coverage; otherwise inconclusive.
- Package version participates in project/workspace fingerprint; enriched reference release changes version. Backend schema and `schema-std` versions remain separate.
- Persist `knownStaleSinceLastIndex` per workspace and aggregate. True aggregate latch short-circuits scans. First proven stale input atomically sets applicable workspace/global latches; only successful index clears.
- Freshness: `current|stale|unknown`; aggregate precedence stale > unknown > current. Read/stat/hash/repository/VCS failures return transient unknown, set no stale state, retry later.
- Batch `AssessIndexedResourceFreshness` handles exact files/documents/specs from persisted observations. Equal mtime+size avoids reads; changed stamps hash; equal content refreshes observation; different/missing content marks stale. Repository inputs use stable revision/fingerprint.
- Resource stale if any input stale; unknown if none stale and any unknown. Exact consumers may use current targeted evidence despite unrelated global stale; corpus-wide absence/uniqueness/ranking/workspace fallback retains global diagnostics.
- Workspaces sharing VCS root share diff evaluation but keep independent latches. Scope identity uses sorted workspace names, never absolute paths. Fingerprint sorts visible `{ path, state, contentHash }` and distinguishes present/missing.
- Filter `VcsAdapter.modifiedFiles()` through indexing visibility: excludes/allows/gitignore/defaults/code-document-spec channels. Fully invisible additions/modifications/deletions/rename sides do not affect health; mixed diffs retain visible paths. Visibility config changes fingerprint.
- Non-VCS workspaces compare visible membership+observations and stop at first mismatch. VCS workspace with `respectGitignore:false` uses hybrid VCS/filesystem for ignored untracked graph inputs.

## Constraints
- VCS-agnostic via `VcsAdapter` from `@specd/core`; refs opaque.
- Detection never triggers reindex.
- Locks, fallback config, config merging, freshness logic live in `@specd/code-graph` or `@specd/core`, not CLI helpers.
